verses.en: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God:
verses.pt: E depois destas coisas, eu ouvi uma voz de uma grande multidão no céus, que dizia: “Aleluia! Salvação, glória, honra, e poder ao Senhor, nosso Deus!
verses.en_web: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God:
verses.en_bbe: After these things there came to my ears a sound like the voice of a great band of people in heaven, saying, Praise to the Lord; salvation and glory and power be to our God:

verses.en: For true and righteous are his judgments: for he hath judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.
verses.pt: Porque verdadeiros e justos são seus juízos; pois ele julgou a grande prostituta, que com sua prostituição corrompia a terra, e vingou da mão dela o sangue dos servos dele.”
verses.en_web: for true and righteous are his judgments. For he has judged the great prostitute, who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”
verses.en_bbe: For true and upright are his decisions; for by him has the evil woman been judged, who made the earth unclean with the sins of her body; and he has given her punishment for the blood of his servants.

verses.en: And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.
verses.pt: E disseram pela segunda vez: “Aleluia! E a fumaça dela sobe para todo o sempre.”
verses.en_web: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”
verses.en_bbe: And again they said, Praise to the Lord. And her smoke went up for ever and ever.

verses.en: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.
verses.pt: E os vinte e quatro anciãos, e os quatro animais, se prostraram, e adoraram a Deus (que estava sentado no trono) e diziam: “Amém! Aleluia!”
verses.en_web: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”
verses.en_bbe: And the four and twenty rulers and the four beasts went down on their faces and gave worship to God who was seated on the high seat, saying, Even so, praise to the Lord.

verses.en: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.
verses.pt: E saiu uma voz do trono, dizendo: “Louvai ao nosso Deus, todos vós os servos dele, e vós que o temeis, tanto pequenos como grandes.”
verses.en_web: A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”
verses.en_bbe: And a voice came from the high seat, saying, Give praise to our God, all you his servants, small and great, in whom is the fear of him.

verses.en: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
verses.pt: E eu ouvi como a voz de uma grande multidão, e como a voz de muitas águas, e como a voz de fortes trovões, dizendo: “Aleluia! Porque o Senhor Deus Todo-Poderoso reina!
verses.en_web: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!
verses.en_bbe: And there came to my ears the voice of a great army, like the sound of waters, and the sound of loud thunders, saying, Praise to the Lord: for the Lord our God, Ruler of all, is King.

verses.en: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.
verses.pt: Alegremos, e fiquemos muito contentes, e demos glória a ele, pois já chegou a festa de casamento do Cordeiro, e a sua esposa já se preparou.
verses.en_web: Let us rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let us give the glory to him. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”
verses.en_bbe: Let us be glad with delight, and let us give glory to him: because the time is come for the Lamb to be married, and his wife has made herself ready.

verses.en: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.
verses.pt: E foi concedido a ela que se vestisse de linho fino puro e brilhante; pois o linho fino são as justiças dos santos.”
verses.en_web: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen: for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.
verses.en_bbe: And to her it was given to be clothed in delicate linen, clean and shining: for the clean linen is the righteousness of the saints.

verses.en: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.
verses.pt: E ele me disse: Escreve: “Benditos são aqueles que foram chamados para a ceia da festa de casamento do Cordeiro.” E ele me disse: “Estas são as verdadeiras palavras de Deus.”
verses.en_web: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to me, Put in the book, Happy are the guests at the bride-feast of the Lamb. And he said to me, These are the true words of God.

verses.en: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
verses.pt: E eu me lancei aos pés dele para o adorar; mas ele me disse: “Olha, não faças isso! Eu também sou companheiro de serviço teu, e de teus irmãos, que têm o testemunho de Jesus; adora a Deus; porque o testemunho de Jesus é o espírito da profecia.”
verses.en_web: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”
verses.en_bbe: And I went on my face before his feet to give him worship. And he said to me, See you do it not: I am a brother-servant with you and with your brothers who keep the witness of Jesus: give worship to God: for the witness of Jesus is the spirit of the prophet's word.

verses.en: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.
verses.pt: E eu vi o céu aberto; e eis um cavalo branco; e o que estava sentado sobre ele era chamado Fiel e Verdadeiro, e em justiça ele julga e guerreia.
verses.en_web: I saw the heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.
verses.en_bbe: And the heaven was open; and I saw a white horse, and he who was seated on it was named Certain and True; and he is judging and making war in righteousness.

verses.en: His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.
verses.pt: E os olhos dele eram como uma chama de fogo; e sobre a cabeça dele havia muitas diademas, e ele tinha um nome escrito, que ninguém sabia, a não ser ele mesmo.
verses.en_web: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.
verses.en_bbe: And his eyes are a flame of fire, and crowns are on his head; and he has a name in writing, of which no man has knowledge but himself.

verses.en: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.
verses.pt: E ele estava vestido de uma roupa tingida em sangue, e o nome dele é chamado “Palavra de Deus”.
verses.en_web: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”
verses.en_bbe: And he is clothed in a robe washed with blood: and his name is The Word of God.

verses.en: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.
verses.pt: E os exércitos no céu o seguiam em cavalos brancos, vestidos de linho fino branco e puro.
verses.en_web: The armies which are in heaven followed him on white horses, clothed in white, pure, fine linen.
verses.en_bbe: And the armies which are in heaven went after him on white horses, clothed in delicate linen, white and clean.

verses.en: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.
verses.pt: E da boca dele saía uma espada afiada, para com ela ferir às nações; e ele as dominará com vara de ferro; e ele pisa na prensa do vinho da ira e da indignação do Deus Todo-Poderoso.
verses.en_web: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword, that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.
verses.en_bbe: And out of his mouth comes a sharp sword, with which he overcomes the nations: and he has rule over them with a rod of iron: and he is crushing with his feet the grapes of the strong wrath of God the Ruler of all.

verses.en: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.
verses.pt: E ele tem sobre sua roupa e sobre sua coxa escrito este nome: “Rei dos Reis, e Senhor dos Senhores”.
verses.en_web: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”
verses.en_bbe: And on his robe and on his leg is a name, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.

verses.en: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;
verses.pt: E eu vi um anjo que estava no sol; e ele clamou em alta voz, dizendo a todas as aves que voavam no meio do céu: “Vinde, e ajuntai-vos para a ceia do grande Deus;
verses.en_web: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God,
verses.en_bbe: And I saw an angel taking his place in the sun; and he was crying with a loud voice, saying to all the birds in flight in the heavens, Come together to the great feast of God;

verses.en: That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, both small and great.
verses.pt: para que comais a carne dos reis, e a carne dos chefes militares, e a carne dos fortes, e a carne dos cavalos e dos que se assentam sobre eles; e a carne de todos os livres e servos; e dos pequenos e dos grandes.”
verses.en_web: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, small and great.”
verses.en_bbe: So that you may take for your food the flesh of kings, and of captains, and of strong men, and of horses and of those who are seated on them, and the flesh of all men, free and unfree, small and great.

verses.en: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.
verses.pt: E eu vi a besta, e os reis da terra, e os exércitos deles juntos, para fazerem guerra contra aquele que estava sentado sobre o cavalo, e contra o exército dele.
verses.en_web: I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse, and against his army.
verses.en_bbe: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, come together to make war against him who was seated on the horse and against his army.

verses.en: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.
verses.pt: E a besta foi presa, e com ela o falso profeta, que diante dela fazia os sinais sobrenaturais, com os quais tinha enganado aos que receberam a marca da besta, e adoraram à imagem dela. Estes dois foram lançados vivos no lago do fogo ardente em enxofre.
verses.en_web: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.
verses.en_bbe: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who did the signs before him, by which they were turned from the true way who had the mark of the beast, and who gave worship to his image: these two were put living into the sea of ever-burning fire.

verses.en: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.
verses.pt: E os restantes foram mortos com a espada que saía da boca daquele que estava sentado sobre o cavalo; e as aves se saciaram com a s carnes deles.
verses.en_web: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came out of his mouth. All the birds were filled with their flesh.
verses.en_bbe: And the rest were put to death with the sword of him who was on the horse, even the sword which came out of his mouth: and all the birds were made full with their flesh.
